document.name: Agate
document.description: Irregular compressed growth bands around an eccentric centre, with fine mineral grain.

document.name: Asphalt
document.description: Dominant near-black binder, fine rough grain and sparse tiny brighter stone flecks.

document.name: Aurora
document.description: Several green-blue-violet curtains with fine vertical filaments and dark space between their folds.

document.name: Autumn floor
document.description: Large rusty leaf masses, ochre patches, sparse golden leaves and dark gaps.

document.name: Bark
document.description: Broad broken vertical furrows under finer longitudinal woody grain.

document.name: Bent ribbons
document.description: Horizontal-position-dependent bending curves a regular ribbon field into a fan of arcs.

document.name: Birch bark
document.description: Quiet pale bark with short horizontal dark scars and faint grey-green mottling.

document.name: Box agate
document.description: Signed-distance contours extend inside and outside the box; rotate the solid or move a slice to explore the bands.

document.name: Brecciated marble
document.description: True 3D Voronoi edge distance separates fragments of old-style Perlin marble with dark mineral grout. All slice axes reveal a different section.

document.name: Brushed gold
document.description: Dense fine horizontal brushing beneath broad soft gold reflection bands with uneven scratch strength.

document.name: Brushed steel
document.description: Cool silver reflections above dense fine horizontal scratches of uneven strength.

document.name: Butterfly fold
document.description: A bilateral domain fold mirrors intricate noise veins around the centre while preserving their internal colour structure.

document.name: Camouflage
document.description: Unequal large olive and tan field shapes engulfing smaller brown and black secondary patches.

document.name: Candy cane / Barber pole
document.description: Clean red and warm-white diagonal bands with a narrow softened edge.

document.name: Capped columns
document.description: Signed-distance contours extend inside and outside the cylinder; rotate the solid or move a slice to explore the bands.

document.name: Caustics
document.description: Thin focused sunlight ridges, weaker secondary lines and calm blue pool water.

document.name: Cell coordinate weave
document.description: Cell identity is the vector of nearest feature lattice coordinates. Small identity-directed coordinate jumps reshape old Perlin bands.

document.name: Cellular frost
document.description: Fractal octaves of Worley F1 combine coarse crystalline lobes with fine frost. Demonstrates new noise inside the existing generic fractal.

document.name: Cellular reliquary
document.description: A smoothed box/torus difference masks old ridged stone with seeded cellular inlay; SDF contours highlight the carving.

document.name: Cellular web
document.description: F2 minus F1 highlights a web where first and second feature-point distances coincide; this differs from actual edge distance.

document.name: Checker
document.description: An 8 by 8 checkerboard.

document.name: Cirrus clouds
document.description: Sparse feather-like high clouds: broad wisps and finer streaks stretched across blue sky.

document.name: Cloud lobe union
document.description: A contiguous union of three broad lobes defines the silhouette independently of noisy interior shading.

document.name: Clouds
document.description: Large calm cloud masses with gentle broad interior brightness changes, soft concave depth and two scales of perimeter breakup.

document.name: Concrete
document.description: Neutral low-contrast mottled cement with fine grain and sparse small light and dark aggregate.

document.name: Contour map
document.description: Topographic contours following one terrain field, with heavier major lines every fourth contour.

document.name: Coordinate lens
document.description: An analytic displacement built from position, a constant vector and a rotation bends gold ribbons inside a fading circular lens. No noise is needed.

document.name: Crosscurrent silk
document.description: Two independently sampled vector fields are added to fold a fine gold silk weave.

document.name: Cumulus
document.description: One contiguous seven-lobed cloud: bright rounded bulges, soft overlapping blue-grey crevices and a common shaded underside.

document.name: Diagonal inlay
document.description: Inverse Euler rotation turns a repeating inlay grid; its origin is translated separately, with explicit composition order. Projecting Z to zero extrudes the planar pattern through the solid.

document.name: Distance crests
document.description: Fragmented ridged crests fade with distance from the centre, using scalar multiplication before colouring.

document.name: Double warp opal
document.description: Two sequential fBm-driven vector warps displace an fBm colour field, folding large forms and finer internal detail separately.

document.name: Desert dunes
document.description: A few sweeping dune crests, lit windward slopes and steep shaded lee faces under fine sand.

document.name: Embers
document.description: Mostly charcoal with sparse narrow red seams and isolated yellow-hot points.

document.name: Fire
document.description: Separate rising flame tongues, hot yellow-white bases and red-orange edges with dark gaps.

document.name: Flowing grout
document.description: A Perlin vector warp bends true Voronoi boundary-distance bands into an irregular ceramic glaze.

document.name: Fog / Mist
document.description: Low-contrast drifting mist with broad calm density changes and a second faint veil.

document.name: Gated alpine
document.description: Broad elevation gates fine ridged detail: valleys stay quiet while the high slopes carry crags. Inspect the elevation, detail and threshold separately.

document.name: Gradient
document.description: A clamped linear ramp from red to blue.

document.name: Granite
document.description: Fine pale crystalline matrix with fewer pink grains and sparse larger dark inclusions.

document.name: Hollow signet — sharp join
document.description: A torus cuts into a box near the front slice and cube surface; signed contours reveal the hollow. Compare hard and smooth difference joins.

document.name: Carved lens — sharp join
document.description: Compare hard and polynomial smooth intersection through distance contours, including negative distances.

document.name: Welded pearls — sharp join
document.description: Compare hard and polynomial smooth union through distance contours, including negative distances.

document.name: Heat map
document.description: Fractal noise through the magma colour map, as if from a thermal camera.

document.name: Ice
document.description: Cloudy frozen material interrupted by two sharper blue-grey fracture systems and sparse faint neighbouring fragments.

document.name: Interference rings
document.description: Two offset concentric wave systems create clean interference lobes without noise.

document.name: Jupiter / Gas giant
document.description: Unequal cream, ochre and red-brown atmospheric belts with curling turbulent boundaries and fine cloud streaks.

document.name: Lava
document.description: Large cooled dark plates split by thin fissures grading from red edges to yellow-hot centres.

document.name: Lawn
document.description: Fine short upright blades over broader moist dark and dry olive grass patches.

document.name: Layered
document.description: A transparent-to-blue horizontal gradient layered over a red-to-green vertical one.

document.name: Local current
document.description: A scalar distance mask attenuates an arbitrary three-component vector warp, concentrating grain flow near the centre.

document.name: Malachite
document.description: Folded emerald growth bands, compressed into multiple irregular green mineral centres.

document.name: Marble
document.description: Quiet pale stone crossed by a few broad folded grey veins and a subordinate hairline system.

document.name: Masked knot
document.description: The knot replaces its interior completely; a distance mask fades grain deflection outside, without using colour transparency as a displacement mask.

document.name: Moiré
document.description: Two clean stripe grids, slightly rotated and detuned, create large emergent interference beats.

document.name: Mossy stone
document.description: Broad quiet moss colonies with modest fine granular growth, darker interiors, ragged edges and very sparse pale lichen.

document.name: Mountain ridges
document.description: A bent branching range with broad dark drainage valleys, midtone slopes and elongated subordinate crests confined to the uplands.

document.name: Nebula
document.description: Large violet and warm gaseous clouds with dark voids, finer eddies and sparse tiny stars.

document.name: Nested corrosion
document.description: Two independent scalar masks place oxidised metal inside a broader patina; neither mask depends on the colour ramp alpha.

document.name: Nested fractal frost
document.description: A ridged fractal sum samples a billowy fractal source, demonstrating a generic noise combinator rather than fixed Perlin octaves.

document.name: Oblique strata
document.description: Signed-distance contours extend inside and outside the plane; rotate the solid or move a slice to explore the bands.

document.name: Ocean
document.description: Long directional rolling waves with crossing disturbances and sparse pale crests.

document.name: Offset medallions
document.description: A translated sampling origin places off-centre enamel medallions in centred repeating cells. Projecting Z to zero extrudes the planar pattern through the solid.

document.name: Onyx
document.description: Broad polished cream and honey layers with quiet translucent-looking depth.

document.name: Ordered cell quilt
document.description: Zero jitter gives a regular feature grid; seeded per-cell values supply a repeatable quilt palette.

document.name: Parchment
document.description: Quiet aged cream paper, soft brown stains, faint fibre mottling and subtly darkened edges.

document.name: Pine
document.description: Eccentric annual rings with compressed and expanded growth, fine longitudinal grain and group colour variation.

document.name: Plaid
document.description: Broad unequal woven bands crossed by fine cream accent threads; translucent intersections deepen the colours.

document.name: Plasma
document.description: Swirling colour: turbulence through a rainbow.

document.name: Polar rosette
document.description: Ten repeated angular sectors turn one off-centre petal into a continuous enamel rosette.

document.name: Prismatic mosaic
document.description: Direct seeded cell RGB colours, with true Voronoi edge-distance gold grouting. Two-dimensional cells are extruded through the cube.

document.name: Radial pearls
document.description: Radial modulo repeats a small tonal shell in concentric rings while keeping angle and depth intact.

document.name: Radial
document.description: A ramp swept around the centre, from red at the top to green at the bottom.

document.name: Red-green saw
document.description: A mirrored two-stop ramp, repeating six times.

document.name: Red-green sine
document.description: A sinusoidal ramp, repeating six times.

document.name: Rings
document.description: Concentric rings from a mirrored circular ramp.

document.name: Rust
document.description: Soft nested oxidation blooms over dark metal, with crisp granular corrosion, dark pits and tiny ochre highlights.

document.name: Sand ripples
document.description: Fine wind ripples with consistent light and shadow, gently varying spacing and independent sand grain.

document.name: Sandstone strata
document.description: Irregular pinching strata with independent fine mineral grain and gentle within-layer colour variation.

document.name: Second-neighbour satin
document.description: Worley F2 traces the second-nearest feature; low jitter retains a patterned grid unlike F1.

document.name: Seeded terrazzo
document.description: A random ramp value per Euclidean Voronoi cell, with thin true-distance grouting around the boundary.

document.name: Smiley
document.description: Transparent ramps used as clipping masks to build a smiley face over a noisy background.

document.name: Smoke
document.description: Drifting vertically stretched smoke plumes with turbulent edges, internal holes and fading tops.

document.name: Hollow signet — soft join
document.description: A torus cuts into a box near the front slice and cube surface; signed contours reveal the hollow. Compare hard and smooth difference joins.

document.name: Carved lens — soft join
document.description: Compare hard and polynomial smooth intersection through distance contours, including negative distances.

document.name: Welded pearls — soft join
document.description: Compare hard and polynomial smooth union through distance contours, including negative distances.

document.name: Spherical isobars
document.description: Signed-distance contours extend inside and outside the sphere; rotate the solid or move a slice to explore the bands.

document.name: Storm front
document.description: Laterally flowing dark storm masses with lighter torn upper wisps and quiet gaps.

document.name: Stretched enamel
document.description: Anisotropic scale stretches enamel medallions into tall lozenges before the cell repeat. Projecting Z to zero extrudes the planar pattern through the solid.

document.name: Stripes
document.description: Hard-edged wrapped stripes made with discontinuous stops.

document.name: Sunset clouds
document.description: Dusk cloud layers: dark silhouettes and orange-pink illuminated wisps beneath a cooler upper sky.

document.name: Sunset
document.description: A clean dusk gradient with softened sea horizon, broad solar halo and faint elongated cloud streaks.

document.name: Swept compass
document.description: An inspectable angular scalar is combined with concentric distance bands to make a brass compass dial.

document.name: Swirly stripes
document.description: Strongly swirled bands with broad variations in deformation and a recognisable underlying direction.

document.name: Terrain
document.description: Coherent landmasses, medium hills and fine highlands with restrained colours and snow only at the highest elevations.

document.name: Tiger eye
document.description: Directional amber mineral fibres with sparse gold highlights and broad chatoyant reflection.

document.name: Tiger fur
document.description: Broad irregular near-black stripes thicken, fork and taper into quiet warm orange fur, with only faint directional hairs.

document.name: Topographic map
document.description: Muted altitude zones with consistent minor contours and a stronger line every fourth elevation interval.

document.name: Toroidal copper
document.description: Signed-distance contours extend inside and outside the torus; rotate the solid or move a slice to explore the bands.

document.name: Twisted brocade
document.description: Height-dependent twist winds gold and navy ribbons around a solid; move an XY slice through z to see the rotation.

document.name: Twisted signet
document.description: A height-dependent twist bends repeated torus distance contours; demonstrates SDFs inside existing domain composition.

document.name: Vector iridescence
document.description: Three decorrelated scalar fields are mapped into RGB, making vector components inspectable as an iridescent material.

document.name: Verdigris
document.description: Exposed copper, brown transitional oxidation and clustered turquoise-green patina interleaved at several scales.

document.name: Volcanic cells
document.description: Three-dimensional Worley gap gives a glowing fracture network through the whole solid. Slice it to see the changing cells.

document.name: Volumetric opal
document.description: Three-dimensional seeded cell colours form a mineral mosaic; unlike the extruded quilt the cells change along every axis.

document.name: Walnut
document.description: Rich dark wood with broad sweeping figure, strongly bent grain and finer embedded dark lines.

document.name: Warped turbulence sum
document.description: The generic turbulence sum samples a domain-warped noise source, building fractured warm mineral facets.

document.name: Water ripples
document.description: Visible curved ripple-highlight fragments from three unequal sources, radial weakening and broad areas of calm blue-grey water.

document.name: Watercolour wash
document.description: Soft translucent blue, rose and ochre washes overlap on quiet warm paper with faint pigment mottling.

document.name: Weathered relic
document.description: Perlin fractal detail erodes box distance contours; a smooth SDF mask reveals old-style marble underneath.

document.name: Wobbly stripes
document.description: Mostly parallel stripes displaced by broad low-frequency side-to-side wobble.

document.name: Wood knot
document.description: Eccentric dark branch grain with merged growth bands, an irregular oval boundary and unequal compression of the surrounding trunk grain.

document.name: Circuit cells
document.description: Worley F1 using chebyshev distance, coloured from feature-point centres outward. Switch the distance metric to compare shapes.

document.name: Pebbled jade
document.description: Worley F1 using euclidean distance, coloured from feature-point centres outward. Switch the distance metric to compare shapes.

document.name: Diamond paving
document.description: Worley F1 using manhattan distance, coloured from feature-point centres outward. Switch the distance metric to compare shapes.

document.name: Zebra
document.description: Crisp black and ivory stripes that bend, compress and split under two scales of deformation.
